I replied to Pree in her direct message: send the truck to **Dock 32**.

That's the dock she gave me on Oct 14 for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Driftwood project. Only she can see that message, and it's the only record of the dock. I asked her to tell me if it has changed since then. I didn't read any channels she isn't in, and I didn't share the dock anywhere else.
